facts.fact: The 3 September 2026 workshop opened work under the national digital development strategy and the PND 2026-2030 toward 700 high-impact digital public services by 2029 (a first portfolio of about 100) and a paper-free administration by 2030; the ministry's action is organised in seven pillars and 40 structuring projects.
